201.description: Charge forecast recorded. `Location` identifies the created forecast's canonical resource path (this service has no dedicated GET for a standalone charge forecast today — the total shows up in `GET /paths/{pathId}/telemetry` once work is enqueued and released against it).

Location.description: Canonical URI of the created charge forecast.

items.description: An exact CPT (Critical Pull Time) and the quantity due at it.

cpt.description: The last moment a parcel in this bucket can be manifested and still make its truck.

quantity.description: Units due by this CPT. int64, not int32: the impl and its JSONB store accept quantities across the full 64-bit range.

sku.description: OPTIONAL (ADR-0045, pack-aware estimate). The SKU this bucket counts. With a `sku`, the response bucket also carries `handles`, `cubeMm3` and `weightG`, estimated from this service's local copy of the SKU's pack levels (never a live lookup). `quantity` stays in EACHES either way. Omit it for a plain bucket, which is returned exactly as before. A blank value is treated as absent.

pickUnit.description: OPTIONAL (ADR-0045), only meaningful with `sku` (sent without one it is a `400 invalid-pick-plan`). `EACH` (the default when `sku` is given without it) estimates one handle per each. `CASE` estimates cases: it needs an active CASE pack level for the SKU (otherwise `422 no-active-case-level`) and a `quantity` that is a whole number of cases (otherwise `422 quantity-not-case-multiple`). Exact, case-sensitive match; any other value is a `400 unknown-pick-unit`. With `sku`, `quantity` must be at least 1.

handles.description: Response only; present when the bucket was sent with a `sku`. What an operator handles to move `quantity` eaches: cases for `pickUnit` `CASE` (`quantity` / units per case), eaches for `EACH`.

cubeMm3.description: Response only; total cube of all `handles`, in cubic millimetres. Omitted (never reported as 0) when the pack level has no size on record.

weightG.description: Response only; total weight of all `handles`, in grams. Omitted (never reported as 0) when the pack level has no weight on record.

items.title: CPTBucket

receivedAt.description: When this forecast was recorded (server clock).

packAware.summary: Pack-aware bucket: 36 eaches of a 12-per-case SKU as CASE is 3 cases (`quantity` stays in eaches)

400.description: Malformed request body (invalid JSON), a missing required field, an invalid field value (e.g. negative quantity), a `pathId` outside the deployment's declared process-path families (`unknown-path-id`), or a NUL character (U+0000) in the body (`malformed-request-body`). For pack-aware buckets: a `pickUnit` other than `EACH` / `CASE` (`unknown-pick-unit`), a `pickUnit` without a `sku` (`invalid-pick-plan`), or a `quantity` below 1 with a `sku` (`invalid-pick-quantity`).

unknownPickUnit.summary: pickUnit is neither EACH nor CASE

value.title: Unknown pick unit
value.detail: unknown pick unit: "PALLET" (want EACH or CASE)

422.description: A pack-aware bucket cannot be estimated as asked. Either `pickUnit` is `CASE` but the SKU has no active CASE pack level in this service's local copy (`no-active-case-level`; an unknown SKU is the same), or `quantity` is not a whole number of cases (`quantity-not-case-multiple`). Nothing is recorded; send the bucket with `pickUnit` `EACH` or without a `sku` to forecast it without a pack estimate.
